samples.question: This image shows a compass dial. The rim circle, the four long tick marks, the four short diagonal marks and the letter N are fixed decoration: they are drawn in exactly the same place in every image of this set, so they never indicate the answer. The needle is the two-triangle arrow through the centre of the dial. Exactly one of its two triangles is filled with a solid colour; the mirror-image triangle on the other side is only a grey outline. Report the direction that the SOLID coloured triangle points, using the image itself and not what a compass normally does. If it points between two of the four long ticks, round to the nearer one; the four short diagonal marks show the exact halfway lines. Answer with exactly one word: up, right, down, or left.
